stories.title: El PAM gana las elecciones en Marruecos sin una mayoría y con una escasa participación

en.title: PAM wins Moroccan elections without majority amid low turnout
en.summary: Morocco held elections with the PAM party winning the most seats but failing to secure an overall majority. Voter participation reached 38.02%, marking the lowest turnout in two decades.

stories.title: Ayuso afirma que el desahucio de Maricarmen se hizo cumpliendo la ley: «No es una decisión nuestra»

en.title: Ayuso states eviction of Maricarmen was carried out according to law: "It is not our decision"
en.summary: Madrid's regional president defended the eviction of an 87-year-old resident, claiming it followed legal procedures. She accused the national government of encouraging ongoing protests against the eviction.

stories.title: Una mujer y su hija mantienen en casa durante años el cadáver de un hombre en Cabrera d'Anoia (Barcelona)

en.title: Woman and her daughter kept a man's corpse in their home for years in Cabrera d'Anoia, Barcelona
en.summary: Police discovered the body of a roughly 75-year-old man in a Barcelona home after neighbors reported not seeing the family for an extended period.

stories.title: Ayuso tilda de violentas las protestas frente al ático por el desahucio de Maricarmen: “Intentan deshumanizar y acosar”

en.title: Ayuso calls protests outside penthouse over Maricarmen eviction violent: "They attempt to dehumanize and harass"
en.summary: Madrid's president characterized demonstrations at a residential building as violent, warning that such an environment represents what residents would experience.

stories.title: Delcy Rodríguez thanks Trump for his cooperation with Venezuela and announces elections without setting a date

en.title: Delcy Rodríguez thanks Trump for his cooperation with Venezuela and announces elections without setting a date
en.summary: Venezuela's acting president addressed the UN General Assembly, thanking Trump for diplomatic cooperation and promising elections without specifying when they would occur. She notably did not mention Nicolás Maduro, who is detained near UN headquarters.

stories.title: Delcy Rodríguez en la ONU: "En Venezuela habrá elecciones, pero una elección debe ser una solución no un generador de conflictos irreconciliables"

en.title: Delcy Rodríguez at the UN: "In Venezuela there will be elections, but an election must be a solution not a generator of irreconcilable conflicts"
en.summary: Venezuela's interim president addressed the UN General Assembly, publicly aligning with Trump while avoiding mention of Maduro, and stated her responsibility to lead the country toward democracy without specifying a timeline.

stories.title: Delcy Rodríguez agradece a Trump su papel en Venezuela y asegura que habrá elecciones sin concretar la fecha

en.title: Delcy Rodríguez thanks Trump for his role in Venezuela and assures that there will be elections without specifying the date
en.summary: Venezuela's president returned to the UN General Assembly, where she criticized the United States without mentioning Maduro, who is imprisoned near UN headquarters. She thanked Trump for his involvement in Venezuelan affairs while stating elections will occur without providing specific timing.

stories.title: Sánchez carga contra Ayuso y Almeida por la “tragedia social” del desahucio de Maricarmen: “Están más preocupados en comprar aticazos”

en.title: Sánchez attacks Ayuso and Almeida over the "social tragedy" of Maricarmen's eviction: "They are more concerned with buying penthouses"
en.summary: The president stated he does not rule out any measures to prevent evictions but acknowledged dependence on coalition partners who have twice rejected his protection proposal.

stories.title: Sánchez culpa a Ayuso y Almeida de la “tragedia social” del desahucio de Maricarmen

en.title: Sánchez blames Ayuso and Almeida for the "social tragedy" of Maricarmen's eviction
en.summary: Speaking from New York, the government president assigned responsibility to regional leaders for the eviction while noting Morocco's increased border control measures near Ceuta and Melilla.

stories.title: Los mejores valores para rentabilizar el "superciclo de la tokenización"

en.title: The best stocks to profit from the "tokenization supercycle"
en.summary: Following recent regulatory approval from the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, investor interest has surged in publicly traded companies positioned to benefit from tokenization developments.

stories.title: El Ibex se mantiene en guardia

en.title: The Ibex remains on guard
en.summary: Markets are cautious ahead of talks between Trump and Xi Jinping, with oil prices above $100 per barrel and rising debt interest weighing on the Spanish stock index.

stories.title: Santander bate al mercado en el seguro de salud de la mano de Aegon

en.title: Santander beats the market in health insurance with Aegon
en.summary: Santander's insurance subsidiary and the Dutch group Aegon grew health insurance premiums by 17.46% in the first half, significantly outpacing the broader healthcare assistance market's 6.91% growth.

stories.title: Zuckerberg presenta un dispositivo de IA tipo amuleto que cabe en un llavero

en.title: Zuckerberg presents a keychain-sized AI amulet device
en.summary: Meta's chief executive introduced Muse, a personal AI assistant described as central to his vision for artificial intelligence, following its successful launch.

stories.title: Cómo abordar la idea del fin del mundo

en.title: How to approach the idea of the end of the world
en.summary: The article provides clarity on debates regarding the probability of human civilization collapse.
